notes.title: Privateers "The Journey" Update Released
notes.notes:
Hey Privateers! We know it has been a LONG time since our last update. Many of you have probably lost hope that we were going to keep working on it. We are sorry it has taken so long. Nonetheless, we are super excited to finally release the lasted changes we have been working on. The theme of this update is "The Journey" and it has a completely new experience for travelling to your event destinations. It also brings in a new "Ambitions" system that randomizes the victory conditions on each play through. After playing with the changes we think it really is getting much closer to our complete vision for the game (but not quite there yet)!

Below is a list of the some of the changes in the build…

---- v0.34.0 ---- (November 2020)
- New travel experience for getting to your mission destination.
- New overworld events used during travel.
- Update tutorial to teach mechanics of new travel scene
- New crew wide buffs which can be applied based on event results.
- Added a new resource called rations which your crew require.
- Without rations your crew will become hungry and starve.
- Victory conditions have been reworked to be randomized per playthrough
- Finished adding the bonuses for several banners
- New UI for viewing your ship statistics
- New UI for viewing your ambition progress (victory conditions)
- Adjust balance around progression of game difficulty
- Changed loot drop formulas. More challenging enemies give much more loot.
- Improved readability of several UI windows
Fixed TONS of bugs that show up in edge cases

notes.title: Boats! Boats! Boats! Update Released.
notes.notes:
Hey Privateers! Our latest update is now live for you to play. The theme of the update is "Boats! Boats! Boats!" and as you can guess, it is filled with new features around ships in the game. We hope you enjoy it! Below is a list of the some of the changes in the build…

---- v0.33.0 ----
- Ships now can have different color themes
- Replaced the in game ships with nicer sprites
- There a multiple types of ship profiles now
- There is new tile tinting for islands and caves to add variety
- Events can now allow you to commandeer ships
- It is possible to capture custom legendary ships with special properties
- A bunch of icons have been added for different abilities
- Fixed a bunch of bugs
- Upgraded engine to Unity 2019.2

notes.title: Next patch is live (v0.32.8)
notes.notes:
A big thanks to everyone for continuing to play and send us feedback and bug reports. Today we have released our next patch which includes a handful of bug fixes and quality of life improvements. The list of changes is below...


 Fix bug allowing bosses to be knocked back through walls
 Disable tutorial be default after completed
 Clean up controls
 Allow configuring scrolling controls
 Fix bug showing notifications over the top of game over window
 Fix some typos
 Scroll screen when mouse is over the edge
 Allow locking the mouse into the screen


We are getting ready to prepare our first major content update for early access. If you have ideas of what you would like to see then let us know on the discussion board!

notes.title: Privateers is going into early release
notes.notes: We have a date! On April 18th, you will be able to download, play, fight monsters, collect loot, and most likely, Die! We at Monster Tree are super excited to start sharing our game with everyone out there.
